### 1987

#### Founding

The cooperative began in **1987** with twelve fishing families sharing a single
cold-storage shed on the east dock of the Port of Kellvik.

> "We never planned to be a business," said founder Marta Ilves in a 2015 interview.

### 2024

#### Results

Revenue grew 14% in 2024 to $2.3 billion, up from $2.02 billion the year before,
according to the audited accounts.

The harbor smells of salt and diesel at dawn, and the gulls gather on the pilings
long before the first boats come in.

- Members who miss the **March** registration deadline forfeit their catch share
  for the entire season.

The plant processed 18,600 tonnes of fish in 2024, of which 62% was exported to the
European Union.
